explanation:
Till 15 sec car has accelerative motion and scooter has constant velocity in entire motion.

Total Distance travelled by the car in 15 sec, = (15)2 = m

Distance travelled by scooter in 15 sec.

= V t = 30 15 = 450 m

Difference between distance travelled by the car and scooter in 15 sec,

= 450 = 112.5 m

Now, assume car catches the scooter in time t,

Car travelled in t sec = scooter travelled in t sec.

+ 45(t 15) = 30 t

337.5 + 45t 675 = 30t

15 t = 337.5

t = 22.5 sec.
